cards.english_title: An Apartment Meth Lab Exposed a Cold-Medicine Supply Chain
cards.korean_desc: 2026년 11월 3일 경찰이 평택에서 13명을 붙잡았다. 다섯 명이 2025년 4월부터 2026년 6월까지 필로폰을 만들었다. 이들은 감기약과 위험한 약품을 사용했다. 경찰은 판매 전 마약과 1억 3천만 원을 압수했다. 11월 3일 경찰은 약품 규제 강화를 요청했다.
cards.english_desc: Police caught 13 suspects in Pyeongtaek on November 3, 2026. Five suspects allegedly produced methamphetamine from April 2025 through June 2026. They used cold medicine and hazardous chemicals during production. Police seized the drugs before sale and recovered 130 million won. On November 3, police requested tighter controls on the medicine.
cards.hook: Cold medicine became meth in a Pyeongtaek apartment.
cards.takeaway_english: The case may push South Korea to watch medicine sales more closely.
cards.takeaway_korean: 이번 사건은 한국의 약품 감시를 강화할 수 있다.

why_it_matters.english: The seized amount was estimated to equal about 40,000 doses.
The case may change how some cold medicines are sold in Korea.
why_it_matters.korean: 이번 사건은 감기약 판매 방식을 바꿀 수 있다.

parties.label: Police
parties.english: They detained four suspects and seized the alleged meth before sale.
parties.korean: 경찰은 피의자 네 명을 구속하고 필로폰을 압수했다.

parties.label: Pharmacist and sellers
parties.english: They allegedly supplied 636,600 cold-medicine tablets for meth production.
parties.korean: 이들은 필로폰 제조용 감기약 63만 6천 정을 공급한 혐의다.

parties.label: Ministry of Food and Drug Safety
parties.english: Police asked it to consider making the medicine prescription-only.
parties.korean: 경찰은 해당 약을 전문의약품으로 지정해 달라고 요청했다.

views.label: Police
views.english: Police say tighter controls on cold-medicine sales could reduce diversion into illegal drug production.
views.korean: 경찰은 감기약 판매 규제가 필요하다고 본다.

views.label: Critical perspective
views.english: The coverage gives police claims but does not report the suspects’ defenses or court findings.
views.korean: 보도에는 경찰 주장만 있고 피의자 반론은 없다.

disagree.english: Others may wait for prosecutors and courts to test the allegations before judging responsibility.
disagree.korean: 다른 사람들은 검찰과 법원의 판단을 기다릴 수 있다.

cards.english_title: LG’s Battery Profit Rises as AI Power Demand Grows
cards.korean_desc: LG에너지솔루션은 2026년 3분기 영업이익 7560억 원을 냈다. 북미 ESS 수요와 회복된 EV 판매가 실적을 올렸다. 미국 세액공제로 4169억 원, 본업 이익은 3391억 원이었다. 9월 말 ESS 수주잔고는 약 160기가와트시였다. 11월 3일, 회사는 2026년 매출성장 전망을 35~40%로 올렸다. 북미 ESS는 2027년 말 70기가와트시 이상을 목표로 한다.
cards.english_desc: LG Energy Solution reported 756 billion won operating profit in Q3 2026. North American ESS demand and recovering EV sales lifted results. U.S. tax credits added 416.9 billion won, while core profit reached 339.1 billion. The ESS order backlog was about 160 gigawatt-hours at September’s end. On November 3, the company raised 2026 revenue-growth guidance to 35–40 percent. North American ESS capacity is targeted above 70 gigawatt-hours by end-2027.
cards.hook: Profit rose 25.7% as ESS demand surged.
cards.takeaway_english: LG is betting that storing power for AI will become as important as powering cars.
cards.takeaway_korean: LG는 AI 전력 저장이 자동차 배터리만큼 중요해진다고 본다.

why_it_matters.english: ESS batteries help supply reliable power where AI data centers need it.
why_it_matters.korean: ESS 배터리는 AI 데이터센터에 안정적인 전력을 보탠다.

why_it_matters.english: Local production may become more important as U.S. battery rules tighten.
why_it_matters.korean: 미국 배터리 규정이 강해져 현지 생산이 중요해질 수 있다.

why_it_matters.english: LG’s outlook shows how battery companies are shifting beyond electric vehicles.
why_it_matters.korean: LG의 전망은 배터리 기업이 전기차 밖으로 움직임을 보여준다.

parties.label: LG Energy Solution
parties.english: It earned more as ESS shipments grew and EV battery sales recovered.
parties.korean: ESS 출하와 EV 배터리 판매 회복으로 더 벌었다.

parties.label: North American customers
parties.english: Utilities, technology companies and data centers are driving demand for local ESS batteries.
parties.korean: 전력회사와 기술기업, 데이터센터가 현지 ESS 배터리를 원한다.

parties.label: U.S. supply chain
parties.english: Tighter rules are pushing LG to localize battery materials and production.
parties.korean: 강화된 규정이 배터리 소재와 생산의 현지화를 압박한다.

views.label: LG Energy Solution
views.english: The company expects more ESS orders because AI data centers need reliable power.
views.korean: 회사는 AI 데이터센터의 안정적 전력 수요로 ESS 주문이 늘 것으로 본다.

views.label: Power-market analysts
views.english: Battery storage can help data centers, but grid limits and high power demand remain concerns.
views.korean: 배터리 저장은 도움이 되지만 전력망 한계와 높은 수요가 걱정이다.

disagree.english: Others may note that tax credits supported results and future orders are not guaranteed.
disagree.korean: 다른 사람들은 세액공제와 미래 주문이 확실하지 않다고 말할 수 있다.

cards.english_title: Minho’s Marathon Time Faces a Touchy Rule Debate
cards.korean_desc: 11월 1일 민호가 서울마라톤을 3시간 18초에 완주했다. 첫 풀코스 완주 뒤 경기 영상이 퍼졌다. 세계육상 규정은 페이스 조절을 허용하지만 밀어주기는 금지한다. 11월 3일 민호는 사과하고 결과를 거부했지만 판정은 없었다.
cards.english_desc: On November 1, Minho finished the JTBC Seoul Marathon in 3 hours 18 seconds. After his first full marathon, race footage spread online. World Athletics rules allow pacing but prohibit physical help that moves runners forward. On November 3, Minho apologized, rejected the result, and organizers still had no ruling.
cards.hook: Minho’s marathon result faces a rule debate.
cards.takeaway_english: The controversy now depends on officials judging contact, not simply seeing it.
cards.takeaway_korean: 논란은 접촉보다 실제 도움을 판정하는 데 달렸다.

why_it_matters.english: Race results depend on fair competition and clear decisions.
why_it_matters.korean: 경기 결과는 공정한 경쟁과 명확한 판정에 달렸다.

why_it_matters.english: Amateur runners need to know what pacemakers may legally do.
why_it_matters.korean: 아마추어 선수는 합법적인 도움을 알아야 한다.

parties.label: Choi Minho
parties.english: He finished his first full marathon, then rejected the result after the controversy.
parties.korean: 첫 마라톤을 완주한 뒤 결과를 거부했다.

parties.label: The pacemaker
parties.english: A runner believed to be Minho’s pacemaker appeared to touch or push his back.

parties.label: Race organizers
parties.english: They had not announced an official ruling by November 3.

views.label: Some viewers
views.english: They saw the contact as encouragement or pacing control, not proven cheating.

views.label: Other viewers
views.english: They believed the contact might have pushed Minho forward and violated the rules.
views.korean: 다른 사람은 밀어주기가 규정 위반이라고 봤다.

disagree.english: The video does not show clearly whether the contact actually helped Minho move forward.

cards.english_title: Russian Strikes Kill 26 After a Ceasefire
cards.korean_desc: 공격은 구호 학교, 이어 인근 대피소를 때렸습니다. 우크라이나 당국은 경찰 4명과 구조대원 2명이 숨졌다고 밝혔습니다. 올레시키 휴전은 위반 보고 없이 6일 뒤 끝났습니다. 미국 주도 회담은 11월 10~11일 아부다비에서 열립니다.
cards.english_desc: The strikes hit an aid school, then a nearby shelter. Ukrainian officials said four police officers and two rescuers died. The Oleshky ceasefire ended after six days without reported violations. US-led talks are planned for November 10–11 in Abu Dhabi.
cards.hook: Russian strikes killed 26 after a ceasefire.
cards.takeaway_english: The November talks must address aid access as well as military de-escalation.
cards.takeaway_korean: 11월 회담은 구호와 군사 긴장 완화를 다뤄야 합니다.

why_it_matters.english: Aid centers can become deadly places when fighting resumes.
The failed pause tests whether humanitarian cooperation can continue.
why_it_matters.korean: 실패한 휴전은 인도적 협력의 지속 여부를 시험합니다.

why_it_matters.english: New talks will discuss security, de-escalation and humanitarian measures.
why_it_matters.korean: 새 회담은 안보와 긴장 완화, 구호를 논의합니다.

parties.label: Ukraine
parties.english: Ukraine says the strikes destroyed peace hopes and killed civilians receiving aid.
parties.korean: 우크라이나는 공격이 평화와 구호를 무너뜨렸다고 말합니다.

parties.label: Russia
parties.english: Russia rejects Ukraine's account of the pause and says the aid mission succeeded.
parties.korean: 러시아는 우크라이나 설명을 부인하고 구호 임무가 성공했다고 말합니다.

parties.label: Civilians
parties.english: Residents were evacuated from Oleshky to Ukrainian-controlled territory and Russian-annexed Crimea.
parties.korean: 주민들은 우크라이나 통제 지역과 크림으로 대피했습니다.

views.label: Ukraine
views.english: Ukraine says the attack sent the opposite signal from peace and targeted people seeking aid.
views.korean: 우크라이나는 공격이 평화와 반대되는 신호였다고 말합니다.

views.label: Russia
views.english: Russia says pauses may be used to regroup and describes the humanitarian mission as successful.
views.korean: 러시아는 휴전이 재정비에 쓰일 수 있다고 말합니다.

disagree.english: Russia disputes Ukraine's account, while the reported death toll could still rise because about 20 people are missing.
disagree.korean: 러시아는 우크라이나 설명을 부인하며 실종자 약 20명이 있습니다.
